meta.title: Pricing | Midway Securities Ltd.
meta.description: BO Account fees, deposits, withdrawals, IPO charges and free services at Midway Securities Ltd.

header.headline: Simple, Transparent Pricing
header.subhead: What it costs to open, fund and use your Midway account.

trading.title: Trading Charges
trading.body: Industry-standard commission rates apply when you buy and sell. Charges depend on the product you trade, and we share your applicable rate when you contact us.

refund.title: Get Your Opening Fee Refunded
refund.body: Buy ৳50,000 or more in stocks within your first month and we refund the ৳150 opening fee.

deposits.title: Deposits & Withdrawals
deposits.note: bKash, Nagad, Rocket and card charges are set by the provider, not Midway.

items.label: IPO Membership Club
items.sub: Sign up once in the Midway Portal. Equity IPOs only.

items.title: Midway Portal
items.body: Account, IPO applications and withdrawals online.

help.title: Questions About a Charge?
help.body: Message us on WhatsApp and we will explain.

disclaimer: Fees are as of the date shown and may change. Charges by third parties (bKash, Nagad, Rocket, card networks and CDBL) are set by those providers, not Midway.
